name: Quadric Tracing
definition: A method to accelerate sphere tracing by precomputing an augmented distance field using quadric surfaces (second-degree algebraic surfaces) to bound or unbound scene geometry, reducing the number of Signed Distance Function (SDF) evaluations.
summary: Quadric tracing accelerates sphere tracing by using precomputed quadric surfaces to bound scene geometry, reducing SDF evaluations and solving slowdowns near surfaces.
